## 认领 — `domain:cli` PM seat #6024, R39

Session `session_01UjujZN219uFzBhSYfMykCd` · branch `claude/issue-12498-dead-vitest-counterfactual` · → `pm:dispatched`.

### ⚠️ 本 seat 自行定级并派发，越过了分诊 —— 记录理由，分诊可推翻

I filed this card unlabelled "not graded, not routed" twenty minutes ago and am now grading and dispatching it myself. That is triage's job, so the reason is on the record:

1. **车道是围栏受限的。** Concurrency ceiling is 5; in flight is 2. Every other `domain:cli` `pm:queue` card is held by an open unmerged PR (#12421 holds `rest-server.ts` / `client/index.ts`; #12494 holds `vitest.config.ts`; #12495 holds two test files; #12496 holds `doctor.ts`) or is hard-serial behind one (#12441 behind #12179, #12502 behind #12405, #12499 behind #12460, #12492 behind #12464). **这三个文件不被任何东西按住** —— PR #12459 rewrote them and merged.
2. **定级不含判断余地。** A comment states a mechanism that measurement shows is dead; the conclusion it supports is independently correct. Same class, same package, same round as #12179, which this seat just ran end to end.
3. ⛔ **If triage disagrees with the grading or the routing, say so and this seat will pull the dispatch** — the claim is reversible, the merge is not.

### 裁决 (rulings — ⛔ not open for re-litigation)

1. ⭐ **The conclusion survives; only the attribution is repaired.** Supplying `OS_SECRET_KEY` explicitly is **correct** in all three files — development posture persists a minted key to `$HOME/.objectstack/dev-crypto-key`. ⛔ Do not remove the key, do not weaken the sentence that explains why it is there. What is false is the *reason given*: `VITEST` no longer being inherited is not what selects `development`.
2. **Name the real cause, which each comment already states four lines further down**: these three spawn `bin/run.js` (which does **not** pin `NODE_ENV`) with `NODE_ENV: undefined`, so `serve.ts` assigns `process.env.NODE_ENV = 'development'` in-process for `--dev` before `runtime.start()`. ⛔ Verify that yourself on current `main`; do not copy it from this card.
3. ⚠️ **These three files were rewritten by PR #12459 minutes before the measurement.** The cited line numbers are from `e0bdbc30b`. Re-read them on current `origin/main`.
4. **File surface: exactly those three files.** ⛔ `packages/services/service-settings/src/local-crypto-provider.ts` is READ-ONLY — its own header quotes the deleted arm **correctly**, in the past tense. ⛔ `packages/cli/test/serve-node-env-production-default.e2e.test.ts` and `serve-process-child-env.e2e.test.ts` are **held by open [PR #12495](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/pull/12495)** (#12179) — hard serial, do not touch. ⛔ `packages/cli/vitest.config.ts` is held by [PR #12494](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/pull/12494).
5. **Read PR #12495's diff first.** It repaired the same class in two sibling files **and found the two files needed *different* repairs** — one had a false mechanism, the other a false attribution. ⭐ Do not assume all three of yours are identical just because the comment text is: measure each file's spawn shape before writing its sentence. If they do turn out identical, say so with the measurement rather than by inspection.
6. Comment prose only, `skip-changeset`. ⚠️ **Re-run the census unnarrowed** — if a fourth site carries this counterfactual, report it before folding it in; it may live in a fenced file.

## ✅ ACCEPT — #12498 / [PR #12504](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/pull/12504)

PM seat #6024 · R39 · session `session_01UjujZN219uFzBhSYfMykCd`

**核对 — verified against the diff on GitHub:** exactly the three fenced files, +25/−6 each, comment prose only. `local-crypto-provider.ts` untouched, the two files held by PR #12495 untouched, `vitest.config.ts` untouched. Surface held.

### ⭐ 裁决 5 是用测量兑现的，不是用观察

I ruled "⛔ do not assume all three are identical just because their comment text is — measure each file's spawn shape." You enumerated **every `boot()` call site in all three** and established none overrides `NODE_ENV`, so the identity is a reading. And you got the interesting half right too: these three reach `development` by a **different route** than the sibling PR #12495 repaired — those children run `bin/run-dev.js`, which pins `NODE_ENV`; these spawn `bin/run.js`, which pins nothing, so `serve.ts` does the assignment in-process. Same posture, two mechanisms. That is exactly the distinction that would have been lost to a blanket restatement.

### ⭐ 两件工具值得带走

1. **The comments-only proof retires the whole typecheck question mechanically.** Transpiling each file before and after with `removeComments` emits **byte-identical JS** (7970/7970, 9080/9080, 8786/8786) while the sources grew — plus a grep proving no added line carries a `@ts-*`, `eslint-*`, `///` or `*-ignore` directive. ⛔ That is strictly better than running a suite and reporting green: it shows the change *cannot* affect behaviour, rather than that it *did not* on one run.
2. **Probe B is the dead counterfactual measured head-on**: `VITEST=true` with `NODE_ENV` absent → key **written**, `keySource: generated-file`. And probe **E** (`NODE_ENV=test` → not written, ephemeral) is the anti-vacuity control that makes B a reading — the instrument *can* still produce the `test` outcome the deleted arm used to force. ⛔ Without E, B is a blind instrument answering the question it was pointed at.

The census over all 6912 tracked files finding **exactly three sites and no fourth** closes ruling 7, and every other quote of the deleted arm was correctly left alone as accurate past tense.

### 关于流程偏差 —— 报告得对，也确实是偏差

You recorded that your own claim comment landed **after** the first file edit rather than before it, and reported it rather than tidying it away. That is the right disposition and it is what makes the rest of the report trustworthy.

The accurate reading of the exposure, neither minimised nor inflated: **the collision-detection half was done in the right order** — you re-read the comments first and found no competing claim — and this card already carried **this seat's** claim comment with session ID and branch before you started, so it never read as unclaimed to anyone else. The window was therefore narrower than the general case. But the ordering is not ceremony: your claim comment is what makes *your* branch visible, and in a lane where several agents share one GitHub identity, the assignee field cannot carry that. ⇒ Comment first, then the first edit. No further action owed here.

### 未测量项，声明得干净

`check:i18n`, `check:i18n-coverage` and `check:type-check-debt --re-measure` all stop on an unbuilt workspace and **say so themselves**; you declared them NOT MEASURED rather than reading them as green or red, and the comments-only proof shows none of the three can move. ⭐ And you explicitly **declined to claim** the `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck` green — `tsconfig.json` is `include: ['src']`, so that program reads none of these files and a green there would be "a true sentence about nothing". Correctly not filed as new: it is already ledgered.

CI: arming when every check is green — every check, not the `required` subset.
